title: Disentangle Compose Server From Repo
description: repo and compose are separate technologies. compose/server compose and k8s must not reference repo paths, images, or services. Caddy in repo must not proxy to compose-session.
summary: compose/server/compose.yml is now postgres + compose-session only: default DB compose_session, no repo schema mount, no web/worker/caddy. compose/server/k8s.yaml is compose-session-only (namespace compose-session): Postgres StatefulSet without repo init SQL, session Deployment with DATABASE_URL from Secret (fixes non-working $(VAR) expansion in env), Ingress with a single backend to session:8788. repo/server/Caddyfile reverted to reverse_proxy web:8787 only.
